svg.title: Pricing support for the sales order
svg.desc: Pricing support for the sales order. Customer and item context connects through price lists, promotions, and override approval to a sales order. Keep the record grains separate. Foreign-key paths, analytical matches, and business context answer different questions; read the numbered evidence table before joining.
